tasks.name: Create text input field
tasks.description: Implement a text input field for users to enter notes.

tasks.name: Add save button
tasks.description: Create a button that allows users to save their notes.

tasks.name: Implement save functionality
tasks.description: Develop backend logic to save notes entered by the user.

tasks.name: Set up database for storing notes
tasks.description: Create a database schema to store user notes.

tasks.name: Connect backend to database
tasks.description: Integrate the backend logic with the database to save and retrieve notes.

tasks.name: Display saved notes
tasks.description: Implement functionality to display saved notes on the page.

tasks.name: Test text input and save functionality
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the text input and save functionality work correctly.

tasks.name: Test database integration
tasks.description: Verify that notes are correctly saved and retrieved from the database.

tasks.name: Deploy application
tasks.description: Deploy the note-taking application to a server or hosting platform.

T1.implementation_approach: Use HTML to create a text input field with an appropriate ID or class for styling and JavaScript interaction.
T1.notes: Ensure the input field is styled for usability and accessibility.

T2.implementation_approach: Add a button element in HTML with an event listener in JavaScript to handle click events.
T2.notes: Label the button clearly as 'Save' for user clarity.

T3.implementation_approach: Write a JavaScript function to capture the input field's value and send it to the backend via an API call.
T3.notes: Validate the input before sending it to the backend.

T4.implementation_approach: Set up a database (e.g., MySQL, MongoDB) with a table or collection to store notes with fields like ID, content, and timestamp.
T4.notes: Choose a database based on scalability and project requirements.

T5.implementation_approach: Use a backend framework (e.g., Node.js, Django) to establish a connection to the database and create APIs for saving and retrieving notes.
T5.notes: Secure the database connection and handle errors gracefully.

T6.implementation_approach: Fetch saved notes from the backend using an API and display them dynamically on the frontend using JavaScript.
T6.notes: Ensure the notes are displayed in a user-friendly format.

T7.implementation_approach: Test the text input and save button functionality manually and with automated tests to ensure data is captured and sent correctly.
T7.notes: Include edge cases like empty input or invalid characters.

T8.implementation_approach: Test the database integration by verifying data is correctly stored, retrieved, and updated using backend APIs.
T8.notes: Use tools like Postman or automated tests for API validation.

T9.implementation_approach: Deploy the application using a hosting service like AWS, Heroku, or Vercel, ensuring all dependencies are configured.
T9.notes: Test the deployed application to confirm all features work as expected.
